title: Network reporting rolls up members, Events and revenue across a Collective
detail:
PHASE 8 of the five-tier ladder (ADR-1709), built on the per-Space Reach report.

Private owner-only Collective report on existing Reach page includes the parent and current active same-owner attached Spaces, deduplicates real active Space role members plus the implicit owner (not paid-tier subscription rows) and actual hosted/owned Events, and sums existing commerce/ticket/gift/split-share earnings with refund rules in strict complete mode. All sources use bounded ID-keyset pages across a read window, not a transactional snapshot; any error, unknown/non-USD currency or truncation renders unavailable, never a partial total. Downgrades and ownership changes deny before finance; manager/staff preview cannot read it. No new menu or production writes.

verify.note: Runs the actual owner/downgrade gates, membership/Event dedupe, complete/unavailable rollup, paginated completeness bound and currency refusal without a test runner; verifies strict financial adapter and Reach wiring.
